<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="390" height="844" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

  <!-- Status bar -->
  <g>
    <text x="24" y="27" font-family="Open Sans, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="600" fill="#000000">9:41</text>
    <line x1="315" y1="22" x2="315" y2="27" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="320" y1="19" x2="320" y2="27" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>

    <line x1="330" y1="13" x2="330" y2="27" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>

    <path d="M338 19 Q344 13 350 19 M340 22 Q344 18 348 22" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="359" y="15" width="22" height="12" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="361" y="17" width="17" height="8" rx="1.5" fill="#000000"/>

  </g>
  <line x1="24" y1="101" x2="366" y2="101" stroke="#F0F0F1" stroke-width="1"/>

  <!-- Illustrated empty state -->
  <g>
    <circle cx="195" cy="329" r="113" fill="#F5F7FC"/>
    <circle cx="195" cy="329" r="88" fill="#EDF2FF"/>
    <polygon points="136,270 143,274 150,270 146,277 150,284 143,280 136,284 140,277" fill="#3865E0"/>

    <rect x="124" y="300" width="142" height="104" rx="10" fill="#000000" opacity="0.08"/>

    <rect x="139" y="313" width="42" height="42" rx="8" fill="#3865E0"/>

    <line x1="148" y1="345" x2="172" y2="345" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>

    <line x1="88" y1="330" x2="104" y2="330" stroke="#ABB9CD" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>

    <line x1="96" y1="340" x2="96" y2="356" stroke="#ABB9CD" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <line x1="294" y1="315" x2="294" y2="329" stroke="#ABB9CD" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>

    <text x="195" y="501" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Open Sans, sans-serif" font-size="15" font-weight="400" fill="#777777">You’re all caught up. New updates</text>
    <text x="195" y="523" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Open Sans, sans-serif" font-size="15" font-weight="400" fill="#777777">and travel reminders will appear here.</text>

      <text x="195" y="582" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Open Sans, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">Explore stays</text>
    </g>
  </g>

  <!-- Bottom navigation shadow and surface -->
  <rect x="0" y="777" width="390" height="70" rx="10" fill="#000000" opacity="0.08"/>

  <!-- Profile tab -->
  <g>
    <circle cx="326" cy="791" r="6" fill="none" stroke="#CCCCCC" stroke-width="2"/>
    <ellipse cx="326" cy="805" rx="11" ry="6" fill="none" stroke="#CCCCCC" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="326" y="831" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Open Sans, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#CCCCCC">Profile</text>
  </g>
</svg>
